titel: Dogs Don't Age 7 Years Per Year

beats.say: Rudi thinks one dog year is *seven* of ours. So Max is basically a *little kid.*
So Rudi throws him a *kiddie party*, with balloons and a party horn. Max is just... *embarrassed.*
The party flopped, so Rudi reads him a *bedtime story.* Max sneaks out the *dog flap.*
Because at one, a dog is more like *fifteen.* A teenager!
By two, it's about *twenty-four.* Then roughly *five* years per birthday.
Scientists at UC San Diego even checked dog *DNA.* Times seven just doesn't *fit.*
So that kiddie party? Max was simply too *cool* for it.
Count *fifteen* for year one, *nine* for year two, then about *five* a year.
And big dogs age even *faster*, so don't skip the yearly *vet check.*
